long_biography.plain_text:
ARMZ Uranium Holding became the platform for Vadim Jivov's move from nuclear-fuel supply into international resource leadership. Trained as an engineer-optician at Moscow Energy Institute, he held senior Techsnabexport posts before becoming ARMZ's chief executive and then president of Uranium One. He later served as an independent director of Renaissance Oil.

Jivov's subsequent activity shifted toward privately held investment and financial businesses. He directed and controlled Vendian Capital Management before its 2024 dissolution. He is now a director and majority controller of Vendian Financial Advisory, an active London company registered for financial intermediation.

Matching full patronymic, May 1963 birth, Moscow education and Uranium One role establish that these are transliterations of the same person; the immutable Jivov spelling is retained.

The immutable record and older Companies House appointments place Jivov in the United Kingdom, while identity-verified current filings record Italy. Italy is proposed only as the blank secondary residence country rather than overwriting the immutable main-residence value.

An issuer biography says Jivov started and sold several businesses, supporting broad Self-made status and a resource-business origin above the import threshold. Public evidence does not identify his starting platform, quantify sale proceeds or establish a reliable net worth, so no more specific origin subtype or valuation is asserted.

Vendian Capital Management and its investment-management partnership dissolved in 2024. The biographies identify them historically and use active Vendian Financial Advisory, where Jivov remains majority controller, for the current Finance & Investments classification.
